dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you want to join up?

dialogues.speaker: Thirona
dialogues.text: Well, if I had to mention something, I don't really want to... That's more Granna's line of thought.

dialogues.speaker: Thirona
dialogues.text: She's a bit impulsive and rough around the edges when doing stuff, and she's very competitive — but that's what's cute about her, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Thirona
dialogues.text: I'd be quite worried for her if she really did manage to join, though.

dialogues.speaker: Thirona
dialogues.text: As such, if she wants in, then I want in along with her.
